notes: Prompt-level parity, NOT a harbor run: both sides ran the same claude-code CLI (2.1.177, deepseek-v4-pro via the parity gateway) inside one long-lived container (fork run_parity.py, 1800 s agent cap). The only difference between sides is the instruction text: the raw upstream prompt vs the adapter's instruction.md. The Harbor task environment, test.sh and [verifier.env] were not exercised; a harbor-run Harbor side is still to be done, coordinated with the Harbor team. Both sides were scored by the adapter's tests/run_test.py (gemini-2.5-pro via the gateway's OpenAI-compatible endpoint), not by upstream run_evaluation.py/aggregate_scores.py. Coverage: 5 cases (idx 9,13,17,5,1) of 132, 3 scored runs per side. Attempt ledger (fork artifacts/driver.log): 34 generation attempts, 7 produced an empty report. Two runs were empty on the first attempt and re-rolled once, and the re-roll was kept (idx-9 original r3, idx-13 harbor r3). Three runs stayed empty after re-roll (idx-13 original r1 and harbor r2, two attempts each; idx-5 harbor r3, one attempt); results.json records them as null and the arrays below score them 0.0. Harbor r1 reports for all 5 cases were reused from an earlier run of the same setup that is not in driver.log. Full proof bundle (reports, per-rubric judge logs, results.json, driver.log) at original_parity_repo (pinned commit 9242ac8).
